about: The AgentCake WordPress plugin's own values (agentcake.php, admin.php, uninstall.php). The middleware's values are in cake_edge.json. page_cache_constant: the constant page cache plugins (WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, Cache Enabler, WP Rocket and others) read as "do not store this page". site_key_pattern and script_path are AgentCake's (agentcake/defaults.json site_key, the /cake.js route); edge/php/tests checks them.
